newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis offers mostly unchanged.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis offers mostly unchanged.

text.p: Rail and truck soymeal offers in U.S. cash markets were mostly unchanged Monday as dealers and end users looked to CBOT soymeal futures for direction.
"So far, everbody is just watching the market to see what it will do this week, and so far, not much is happening," one Indiana dealer said.
As of 1025 CST, March soymeal was unchanged at $257.60 per ton.
Another Indiana dealer said his supplies were tight following a half-day of downtime at a local crushing plant last week.
A supply buildup from the recent brisk crushing pace was also expected to weigh on soymeal values as the week wears on, dealers said.
"As this crush continues at such a heavy pace, you should see a lot of meal in the system soon," said one Indiana-based truck dealer.
